class_guess: Bouncer + Chaotic Edge: period-10 bulk on a left wall, 7-bounce junction, chaotic edge identical to #13's
summary: Exact period-10 bouncer and 7-bounce junction; every 7th bounce stirs a chaotic edge Z, the same edge as #13.
mechanism: Bulk 0^inf <A 0 (1101101101)^n on a left wall, rebuilt one cell further left each bounce (62n steps); a fixed junction cycles through 7 exact words H_0..H_6 and the bulk gains one block per 7 bounces.

6 of 7 bounces never touch the edge Z; the 7th applies an edge map Z -> Phi(Z) independent of n (2077/2077 matches with the 1e9 run). Phi is chaotic: |Z| 143-563 over 5e6 visits (~5e15 steps), no repeat, no halt.

Z is cell for cell #13's tail (#13 tail at bounce c-6 = fixed 58-cell word + our Z at bounce c, 1,952/1,952 visits). Halting needs 0 0 0 E> 0; 38,720 near misses 1 0 0 E> 0, all in the edge. Bounces 0-300 (period-5 junction) are plain simulation.

template.diff: class template, not a near neighbour (same skeleton as #13's comparison)
template.note: Shape carries over: left wall via sideRLs_wall, everything else as the right side, k-bounce BigStep (ours k=7, theirs 128). TM1's RInc is a native symbolic check of RC i -> RC (1+i), which needs the edge to be eventually periodic in i; ours is chaotic, so RInc has no analogue. InfiniteRect_v1.v needs eventually periodic crossing streams per column, which the edge never reaches. A closed-language certificate (CTLCertv1.v / CTL62 solve_cert) is the only formal route seen.

strategy: Same reduction as #13: wall + bulk sweeps (ind, 12n and 50n) + 6 exact junction bounces reduce non-halting to the edge map Z -> Phi(Z). That edge is #13's edge, so any closed language found for #13 transfers here (and likely to #34, #36, R6). No such language is known.
risks: The edge lemma is the whole problem and is the one #13 was parked on (SFT_k refuted k<=36, n-gram CPS fails n<=26 there).
|Z| is bounded only empirically (143-563 over 5e6 edge visits); a long transient could still reach 0 0 0 E> 0.
Proving the six junction bounces and Phi's n-independence in Rocq needs LongN/InfiniteRect-style side plumbing (15-30 KB).
